title: Standup notes
audience: For developers who'd rather not reconstruct yesterday from memory at 9:58.
description: Daily standup notes, newest first. Claude Code writes yesterday from your commits; ChatGPT or Claude from what you tell it.
seoTitle: Daily standup template for Claude Code and ChatGPT
note:
Standup notes

Yesterday, today and blockers, one section a day, newest first. Claude Code can write yesterday from your commits.

## Blockers

## Days

prompt.default: Use my Amber Notes note "Standup notes". Each morning I'll tell you what I did yesterday and what's next. Add a section at the start of "Days" with append_to_note (at_start): a "###" heading with today's date, then Yesterday, Today and Blockers as short bullets. Anything blocked also goes under "Blockers"; when I say it's unblocked, remove it with edit_note.
prompt.claudeCode: Write today's standup into my Amber Notes note "Standup notes". Run git log --since=yesterday --author="$(git config user.email)" --oneline in this repo, turn the commits into two to five plain-language bullets (no hashes), and ask me what's next and what's blocking me. Then add a section at the start of "Days" with append_to_note (at_start): a "###" heading with today's date, then Yesterday, Today and Blockers. Anything blocked also goes under "Blockers".

asks: What was I blocked on last week?
Summarize my standups since Monday for the sprint review.

args.text: - Waiting on API keys for the staging payment provider
